page.overview:
Who is Cornelius?

Cornelius is a former bookbinder from Westruun. After Umbrasyl and the Herd of Storms attacked the city, Cornelius took up a leadership position among the refugees. As an NPC, Cornelius is played by Matthew Mercer.

Cornelius is a man in his mid-forties. He has blondish hair and a scruffy beard. His calloused hands give him the appearance of a working man. He has a bright white toothy smile.
